qualifying_findings.title: iFlytek astron-agent knowledge-space authorization bypass

visible_dates.qualification_basis: NVD visible last-modified timestamp within the exact collection window

qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: public NVD vulnerability record; referenced public proof-of-concept
qualifying_findings.factual_summary: NVD states that astron-agent through 1.1.2 lets an authenticated remote caller manipulate the knowledge-list space-id argument and bypass authorization. The record says public exploit material exists; its CISA SSVC entry records proof-of-concept exploitation status.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: astron-agent Console Knowledge-List Endpoint, FileInfoV2Service.listKnowledgeByPage; versions through 1.1.2; remote authenticated caller
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Knowledge-space isolation is a tenant and data-boundary control for agent knowledge stores. A caller who can select another space can expose data outside the authority granted to an AI workflow or its user.
qualifying_findings.upstream_routing: The astron-agent product/entity background belongs in ai-wiki. Retain only the authorization and knowledge-boundary implication in this security wiki.
qualifying_findings.confidence: medium: NVD has precise affected component, version, and update timestamp, but the vendor response and fixed release are not established in the cited record.
follow_up_actions: At ingest, verify whether an upstream astron-agent entity page already exists and link it rather than duplicating product background.
Locate a maintainer advisory or release before stating remediation; do not infer a fixed version from the proof-of-concept.

qualifying_findings.title: github-kanban-mcp-server issue-list command injection

visible_dates.qualification_basis: NVD visible last-modified timestamp within the exact collection window

qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: public NVD vulnerability record with linked maintainer patch and release
qualifying_findings.factual_summary: NVD describes OS command injection in github-kanban-mcp-server's handleListIssues path when state or labels arguments are manipulated. It identifies version 0.4.1 and patch 253d93bbdf7ee9fe42bd8fdf15feea93ae59cbae as remediation references.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: Sunwood-ai-labs github-kanban-mcp-server through 0.4.0; handleListIssues; remote attack path with user interaction required according to the NVD CVSS record; fixed in 0.4.1 per linked release
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: An MCP server converts agent-provided issue filters into an operating-system command boundary. Input that reaches a shell can turn a seemingly read-oriented tool call into host compromise.
qualifying_findings.upstream_routing: The MCP server catalog and general product context are upstream ai-wiki material. This repository owns the agent-to-host command-execution boundary and remediation evidence.
qualifying_findings.confidence: high: NVD record names the affected function and version boundary and links both a patch commit and 0.4.1 release.
follow_up_actions: At ingest, confirm the patch changes the argument-to-command construction before writing control guidance.
Keep this distinct from other MCP command-injection records because its boundary is issue-list filtering.

qualifying_findings.title: ag-ui HttpAgent remote information disclosure

visible_dates.qualification_basis: NVD visible publication timestamp within the exact collection window

qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: public NVD vulnerability record with linked public issue and patch proposal
qualifying_findings.factual_summary: NVD reports remote information disclosure in ag-ui through 0.0.58 in the TypeScript client HttpAgent component. The record says public exploit material exists and links an issue and pending pull request.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: ag-ui TypeScript client sdks/typescript/packages/client/src/agent/http.ts; versions through 0.0.58; remote unauthenticated vector in the cited CVSS record
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Agent-client transports often carry model context, tool results, and user data. A disclosure defect at the HttpAgent boundary can expose that context outside the intended caller or service boundary.
qualifying_findings.upstream_routing: General AG-UI protocol and package background belongs in ai-wiki. Preserve the security-specific transport-disclosure implication and unresolved patch status locally.
qualifying_findings.confidence: medium: NVD provides a precise file and version range, but its record does not describe the disclosure mechanism and the linked fix is still a pull request.
follow_up_actions: Review the linked issue and pull request during ingest to identify the disclosed data and the accepted fixed release.
Do not assert that a patch is released until the project publishes a release record.

qualifying_findings.title: Prefab UI generative sandbox Deno-permission escape

visible_dates.qualification_basis: NVD visible publication timestamp within the exact collection window

qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: public NVD vulnerability record with linked GitHub security advisory, patch, and release records
qualifying_findings.factual_summary: NVD states that Prefab UI's Generative UI sandbox allowed caller-supplied Python to reach unrestricted Deno read, write, and network APIs through Pyodide's JavaScript bridge. In FastMCP deployments using the GenerativeUI provider, a reachable generate_prefab_ui tool could forward code into that boundary. Affected versions are 0.14.0 through 0.20.2; 0.21.0 revokes permissions before code acceptance and starts Deno with --no-prompt.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: prefab-ui Generative UI sandbox; 0.14.0 through 0.20.2; FastMCP GenerativeUI provider integration; fixed in 0.21.0
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Code drafted by an LLM or supplied through an agent-facing UI tool must remain confined. A sandbox with inherited host file and network permissions converts an autonomous code-generation feature into a server-level execution boundary.
qualifying_findings.upstream_routing: Prefab UI, FastMCP, Pyodide, and Deno product background belong in ai-wiki. This security wiki owns the sandbox-permission escape, exposed agent-tool condition, and 0.21.0 mitigation boundary.
qualifying_findings.confidence: high: NVD gives the full affected and fixed ranges, specific mitigation mechanics, integration condition, and linked advisory/patch/release evidence.
follow_up_actions: At ingest, verify the GitHub advisory and 0.21.0 release still expose the stated fixed-version boundary.
Create a local security leaf focused on permission revocation and tool reachability, not a duplicate Prefab UI product page.

upstream_routing_notes.local_retention: agent-facing generated-code sandbox permission escape and mitigation
